title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-08-31-r34.

This cumulative reader preserves Korean EGA material admitted by source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme; and a contiguous translation of EGA II through §2.1.1, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1358. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22209381 identifies this immutable r34 checkpoint. Working repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko.

The r34 increment translates Proposition §1.7.15 with its complete proof and begins Chapter II §2 with the complete notation §2.1.1, canonical lines 1294–1358. The proposition preserves both alternatives on the base—the underlying space of Y is noetherian, or Y is a quasi-compact scheme—and proves that an affine finite-type Y-scheme embeds as a closed Y-subscheme of V(E) for a finite-type quasi-coherent module sheaf E. Its proof retains the finite-type algebra, generating submodule, symmetric-algebra surjection and resulting closed immersion.

Section §2.1.1 records the positive grading of S, the ideal S_+, graded modules with integer degrees, Veronese ring S^(d), residue-class modules M^(d,k), shifts M(n), homogeneous bases for graded free modules, and finite presentations by degree-zero maps. It preserves S_n=0 for negative n, every index range, printed-page boundary II 20 and the source-synchronized forward reference to §2.1.2.

The admitted canonical prefix is 61,676 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 C1FB25C258ACDF3695C671A917056D1BE63DF1A099987C6910D82A08FC593118. The new 3,198-character source slice is 3,290 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 C507C1A7E6F3B94D1DF0320A7B7A6965EDAEC71389A05FB8B4DD7CAB27B10A7D. The Korean target is 62,449 bytes, SHA-256 A4D82A0A67936DFF1507C8D679471E431731F69CE04E27BE39464FF2DC286885; its admitted increment is 3,272 bytes, SHA-256 3B2BCB905ABEE07E4B11209D7AE9D326CAAFABB038E8A35444F89129A2691AE4.

The cumulative PDF has 235 pages, 1,462,350 bytes, SHA-256 EBC2FB3338619430EAB73AC47D25205D21A8645725C7D2452A5624D0982C83C8, and retains 224 historical printed-page markers. Evidence binds editable TeX, coverage, source authority, terminology and translation controls, reproducible build logs, extraction, links, selected renders and SHA-256 inventories. The build fails closed on identity, order, boundaries and target hashes. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts lack complete ToUnicode mappings: extracted mathematical text is not lossless; TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. Hard reproducible checks establish tested properties, not perfection. Defects and uncertainties are corrected in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories or cited third parties.
